displayName: Second Serve: availability SLO fast burn (5xx)

conditions.displayName: 5xx error ratio > 14.4x burn of 99.9% SLO (5m and 1h windows)

conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query: (sum(rate(run_googleapis_com:request_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", service_name="__SERVICE__", response_code_class="5xx"}[5m])) by (service_name, location) / sum(rate(run_googleapis_com:request_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", service_name="__SERVICE__"}[5m])) by (service_name, location) > (1 - 0.999) * 14.4) and (sum(rate(run_googleapis_com:request_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", service_name="__SERVICE__", response_code_class="5xx"}[1h])) by (service_name, location) / sum(rate(run_googleapis_com:request_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", service_name="__SERVICE__"}[1h])) by (service_name, location) > (1 - 0.999) * 14.4) and (sum(rate(run_googleapis_com:request_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", service_name="__SERVICE__"}[1h])) by (service_name, location) > 0.05)

documentation.content: Users are getting server errors. Check Error Reporting and Cloud Run logs for `jsonPayload.event="unhandled"`. Roll back with `gcloud run services update-traffic second-serve --to-revisions=PREVIOUS=100 --region=asia-south1`. Min-volume guard lowered to 0.05 req/s for pilot traffic (skill default 1 req/s).
